TOUHOUANCIENTS-DREAM_CHOICE_INDIGO: Indigo Frenzied Dream: damage dealt always increases when the dream changes.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DREAM_CHOICE_AZURE: Azure Melancholic Dream: Block gained always increases when the dream changes.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-DREAM_CHOICE_KARIYASU: Kariyasu Bewildering Dream: cards generated always increase when the dream changes.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BUBBLE_ILLUSION.title: Bubble Illusion
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BUBBLE_ILLUSION.descripti:
Randomly changes the damage dealt by [blue]-1~3[/blue].
Randomly changes the Block gained by [blue]-1~3[/blue].
Randomly changes the number of cards generated by [blue]-1~1[/blue].
After the change, values are never lower than [blue]1[/blue].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-RECOMMEND_HINT:
Click to open the Steam Workshop page. Right-click to hide.
[gold]You can turn off these recommendations in Settings.[/gold]
TOUHOUANCIENTS-AKYUU_RECOMMEND.title: Hieda no Akyuu
TOUHOUANCIENTS-AKYUU_RECOMMEND.descripti: Try out the [pink]Akyuu[/pink] mod as a playable character!
TOUHOUANCIENTS-YAKUMO_AKAI_RECOMMEND.des: Try out the [gold]Akai Yakumo[/gold] mod as a playable character, from the Touhou fan fiction novel "Gensokyo Player"!
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HOUJUU_NUE_RECOMMEND.desc: Try out the mod that makes the mysterious, uncanny [rainbow]Nue Houjuu[/rainbow] a playable character!
TOUHOUANCIENTS-KIJIN_SEIJA_RECOMMEND.des: A rebellious amanojaku. Try out the [purple]Seija Kijin[/purple] mod as a playable character, featuring cheat-like abilities that modify card values!
TOUHOUANCIENTS-KIJIN_SEIJA_RECOMMEND_2.d: Try out another [purple]Seija Kijin[/purple] mod as a playable character, built around self-damage, healing, and even stronger and more dangerous Rare cards!
TOUHOUANCIENTS-KOMEJI_KOISHI_RECOMMEND.d: Ready for an encounter between the [purple]Unconscious[/purple] and the [blue]Rose[/blue]?! Come play with the [purple]Unconscious[/purple] girl, [green]Koishi Komeiji[/green]!
Gensokyo Spire is a Touhou Project-themed content expansion mod featuring new events, new enemies, and more.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MOKOU_RECOMMEND.title: Fujiwara no Mokou
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MOKOU_RECOMMEND.descripti:
An immortal human. Incinerates problems and does not fear death.
Try out the [red]Fujiwara no Mokou[/red] mod as a playable character!
TOUHOUANCIENTS-KEINE_RECOMMEND.title: Keine Kamishirasawa
TOUHOUANCIENTS-KEINE_RECOMMEND.descripti: Try out the [blue]Keine Kamishirasawa[/blue] mod as a playable character, able to compile and manipulate history!
